scope: Finite documented model-selection portability snapshot, not Anthropic internal tests or live model calls. General Claude Code selectors are tested for portability, not asserted valid in every subagent frontmatter.
overlap: Each input is counted once. Family aliases overlap selector/subagent/native lists; three API IDs (claude-sonnet-5, claude-fable-5, claude-opus-5) also occur in the canonical Copilot catalog. Model-overview current/legacy IDs are a subset of the API enum.

model-config.note: All nine main-table selectors and five additional explicit context examples. Aliases depend on provider/environment/account restrictions; default resets the account default, best is conditional, opusplan switches by phase. Fable pin 5.1 differs from the Claude apps gateway 5.0 default. Context syntax is documented but unsupported here, even where redundant in Claude.

subagents.note: Family aliases, full IDs and inherit. CLI project pins do not resolve parent/provider/account state. VS Code inherit preserves intent, not the original parent identity.

api-enum.note: All 19 explicit Model enum IDs. Dated IDs have no independently established exact-snapshot counterpart; Mythos is restricted/unavailable in this Copilot catalog, and unlisted older versions are not auto-upgraded.

model-overview.note: Four current and nine legacy IDs overlap the API enum; four literal latest Bedrock IDs are representative provider forms, not portable Copilot IDs.

api-primer.note: Additional dated Sonnet example; no exact dated counterpart established.

copilot-catalog.note: Lead-reported advertised CLI completion snapshot: exactly 11 canonical Claude IDs, recorded in copilot-catalog rows. GitHub documentation corroborates names. NOT account availability, parser acceptance, dispatch, context-window or enforcement evidence. Not queried by tests. The fast dotted ID exists only in this catalog; no hyphenated Anthropic fast spelling is inferred.

provider-synthetic.note: ARN, Foundry deployment and gateway names below are synthetic representative forms, NOT literal documented or real identities. Arbitrary custom/provider IDs cannot be enumerated exhaustively.

vscode-native.note: Local native Claude-format allowed values: sonnet, opus, haiku, inherit. No Fable, explicit ID or guessed picker-label conversion. Installed VS Code not verified.
